data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year movements of GBP 5.8m in 2014, comprising GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving and GBP 0.4m movement in premiums, net of reinsurances

prior_year_events.impact_description: one case which was being vigorously defended at the start of the year was forced in to a settlement by the reinsurers. Net of reinsurance recoveries, this claim settled at GBP 1.1m. Further reserves were then posted to the 2010 year of account to cater for claims still to settle or to be received.

named_events.loss_description: impacted a number of properties and also both the 2012 and 2013 years of account.
three reinsurance recovery events taking place, one of which was only notified post year-end, but has been catered for in the ultimate gross loss ratio of 133%.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3334 reported a prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 5.4 million in 2014, representing 19.25% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by adverse movements in claims reserving, including large loss development from UK, Canadian, and Irish liability awards. Specifically, a GBP 1.8 million gross impact related to a 2010 year of account claim settlement contributed to the strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving
GBP 0.4m movement in premiums, net of reinsurances
remaining movements in the closed years in calendar year 2014 have largely stemmed from UK and Canadian liability awards, and to a lesser extent, Irish liability awards.
